name: Mbanza-Ngungu

routes.outcome: Official Ministry directory loaded and listed Mbanza-Ngungu in Kongo-Central cadastral/land jurisdictions.
Journal officiel text evidences creation of Mbanza-Ngungu/Ville and Mbanza-Ngungu/Territoire land jurisdictions, with city/territory scope descriptions.
Public BIC cadastral landing page loaded and linked to a cadastral map/search application.
Current public JavaScript exposed the public Supabase host and cadastral_parcels_public table; only the public viewer configuration was inspected.
Anonymous safe-field city-name query returned an empty array.
Anonymous safe-field bounded extent around the WUP point returned an empty array; this is an extent miss only.
An initial request used a mistyped public project key and was rejected as Invalid API key; no data was exposed and the corrected public-key request is recorded above.

schemaAndCrs.geometryCrs: The public viewer/table exposes latitude, longitude, and gps_coordinates fields; no geometry response was returned, so no CRS conversion was performed.
schemaAndCrs.nativeIdentity: The public viewer identifies parcel_number as the parcel identity field and the table also exposes id. No identity value was returned and no synthetic identity was created.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: two corrected public GET queries using only safe identity/location fields: Mbanza-Ngungu city filter and a bounded extent around the exact WUP point

localCustodianAssessment: The DRC Ministry of Land Affairs is the first-party national custodian; its official directory and the Journal officiel establish the local Mbanza-Ngungu city and territory cadastral jurisdictions. BIC is a separate public cadastral information service, not treated as the local government custodian.

qualification.reason: A local cadastral jurisdiction is first-party evidenced, but no bounded anonymous parcel geometry or native parcel identity was returned; adapter qualification remains a separate serial review.

scopeLimits: The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted.
Empty city-name and bounded extent queries are misses only, not evidence of citywide parcel absence.
The Ministry sources prove local jurisdiction/custodian evidence, not public geometry coverage or API integration.
No GeoJSON sample is retained because no safe full parcel polygon was returned.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, or personal fields were requested or retained.
Larger unchanged HTML/JavaScript and response evidence is under ignored tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/1582/.
uncertainty: The local jurisdiction is first-party evidenced. Anonymous BIC reachability and public table schema are evidenced, but coverage, completeness, geometry availability, update cadence, licensing, and runtime adapter behavior remain unresolved. The packet is complete for attempt 1 and remains held for serial review.
